courses.title: Levonorgestrel — contraception counselling without inventing doses

lessons.title: Emergency vs ongoing contraception
lessons.body: Levonorgestrel appears in EC packs and long-acting devices. Educational counselling: clarify the product in hand, STI protection limits, and escalate for ongoing method choice — Materia does not publish timing windows here.

lessons.title: Enzyme inducers and reliability
lessons.body: Rifampicin–hormonal contraception teaching is about escalating reduced reliability to the clinician, not inventing a backup pill schedule. Confirm against current SA guidance and the labelled products.

quiz.prompt: A patient on rifampicin asks about her combined pill. Best educational frame?
choices: Flag enzyme-induction risk and escalate clinically — do not invent a dose or backup schedule
quiz.teachFromMiss: Interaction counselling means escalate — Materia never invents contraceptive dose or timing rules.
